trust_decision.summary: The decision 'is this login/password pair valid?' is made by a bcrypt comparison of the supplied password against the stored hash inside UsersManager.logUser (users-manager.service.ts:87-99); the advisory's property - an unknown login costs the same as a wrong password - holds only if every rejecting branch on the way there still performs one bcrypt compare (comparePassword, common/functions.ts:71-78, already burns against a dummy hash when the hash is null).

landing_point.why: This is the default AuthProvider (auth-providers.ts:17-22) reached from POST /api/auth/login via AuthLocalStrategy (auth-local.strategy.ts:21); the early 'if (!user) return null' is the branch that skips bcrypt entirely, so an unknown login answers in ~1 ms while an existing one pays a full bcrypt work factor.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP Basic on WebDAV routes (webdav-context.decorator.ts:9) and POST /api/sync/clients/register, both scoped, which reach validateAppPassword through logUser:91
fix_sites.module_kind: second credential-verification path (app passwords) - looks out of scope next to the login form

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/token, WebDAV Basic, POST /api/sync/clients/register when auth.provider=mysql (default)
same four routes when auth.provider=ldap; local-password branches at 41-44 and 65-68
same four routes when auth.provider=oidc; local-password branch gated by isGuest/isAdmin/scope/enablePasswordAuth

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The OIDC (and equally the LDAP) provider branch is only live when configuration.auth.provider selects it (auth-providers.ts:10-15), so on the default MySQL deployment it reads as dead code that the reported POST /api/auth/login flow never executes; the same shape of argument - 'app passwords are a separate scoped feature, the login form sends no scope' - covers the validateAppPassword site at users-manager.service.ts:287-308.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Local-password policy denial must stay a denial: with enablePasswordAuth off, a non-guest/non-admin user (and with LDAP, a non-admin when enablePasswordAuthFallback is off) must still be refused - an over-broad 'just call logUser so the timing matches' fix converts the timing mitigation into a real local-password authentication bypass. Second coupled contract: logUser's HttpException('Account locked', 403) must survive the provider's try/catch instead of becoming a 500, which is why the fix added the `e instanceof HttpException` rethrow in the MySQL provider.

O6_input_shapes: login or email identifier (users-queries.service.ts:103 matches either column)
no user row at all for the identifier
user found but local password auth denied by policy (not guest/admin/scoped, enablePasswordAuth off; LDAP: non-admin with fallback disabled)
scoped credential (AUTH_SCOPE.WEBDAV or AUTH_SCOPE.CLIENT) where an app password is also tried after the local hash fails (users-manager.service.ts:90-92)
secrets row missing or appPasswords not an array (users-queries.service.ts:130-133 returns {})
app password present but filtered out by scope mismatch or by expiration (users-manager.service.ts:291-294)
role without USER permission (guest/link accounts, haveRole at user.model.ts:218-220) on a scoped route

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fourth AuthProvider (SAML/Kerberos/API-key) added to the selectAuthProvider switch with its own findUser-then-logUser and its own early return
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This switch is the plugin point and already holds three near-identical implementations; adding a provider by copying auth-provider-mysql.service.ts is exactly how a maintainer would do it, and the copy would omit the burn.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a revived HTTP Digest strategy that resolves the user and checks a digest secret itself
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file is a complete but commented-out strategy kept in-tree; enabling it produces a second credential-verification route into the same login decision with no dummy-bcrypt burn.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third AUTH_SCOPE (e.g. an editors scope) feeding validateAppPassword through a new guard
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The editors subsystem (Collabora/OnlyOffice) already authenticates separately; adding a scope for it is the natural extension and lands straight in the app-password sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a link-password check against the owner's stored hash that branches on link/user state before comparing
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: linkAuthentication already verifies a credential against the owner's user row via compareUserPassword; a maintainer adding a link-scoped variant would copy this shape and could add an existence branch before the compare.

O9_family: Username/login enumeration through an observable timing discrepancy in credential verification (CWE-208/CWE-203), as an incomplete fix of a prior timing-enumeration advisory

services: MySQL (drizzle-orm + mysql2; migrations in backend/migrations) for running the app

O10_build.project_tests: Vitest unit specs colocated with sources: backend/src/applications/users/services/users-manager.service.spec.ts (mocks comparePassword and counts calls), auth-provider-mysql/ldap/oidc.service.spec.ts, auth.controller.spec.ts, plus backend/src/authentication/auth.e2e-spec.ts; run with `npm test` (unit) and `npm run test:e2e` in backend/.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add one `await comparePassword(password, null)` before the `if (!user) return null` early return in AuthProviderMySQL (and the same in findUser) - which equalises the default /api/auth/login route but leaves the LDAP/OIDC providers, the policy-denied branch (canAuthenticate) and the app-password branches (role-denied, non-array secrets, scope/expiry-filtered lists on the WebDAV and sync-client routes) answering fast.

out_of_scope_notes: The LDAP provider throws a distinct HttpException('User not found', 401) at auth-provider-ldap.service.ts:87-90 after a successful directory bind when autoCreateUser is off - an explicit local-account oracle through an error message rather than timing; a different mechanism from this advisory, not pursued.
